clue.text: After exam, a great place in life

indicators.note: the second piece follows the first, so the exam comes before the great place

parts.note: a viva is an oral university examination
a city is a large and important town

explanation.surface: A student, having sat an exam, praises some wonderful spot to live.
explanation.definitionFit: Vivacity is liveliness, which is the 'life' in someone who is full of life.

clue.text: Old republic is very pleasant around end of June

indicators.note: the very pleasant letters wrap round the last letter of the month

parts.note: nice means pleasant

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of the word June

explanation.surface: A former state is found to be lovely in late June.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts E, the end of June, between V and NICE.
explanation.definitionFit: Venice was an independent maritime republic for about a thousand years until 1797.

clue.text: Vicious criticism of musical group among numbers of Romans

indicators.note: the musical group is placed among the Roman numerals

parts.note: VI and L are Roman numerals, six and fifty
a trio is a group of three musicians

explanation.surface: Harsh reviews of a band, delivered by Romans.
explanation.definitionFit: Vitriol, literally sulphuric acid, is used figuratively for bitter, caustic criticism.

clue.text: Hurls tree, showing beef

parts.note: chucks means throws or hurls
teak is a hardwood tree

explanation.surface: Someone flings a tree about, putting on a show of strength.
explanation.definitionFit: Chuck steak is a cut of beef from the shoulder and neck.

clue.text: Cheat Mack, and add a little sadism?

parts.note: to twist someone is slang for cheating or swindling them
Mack the Knife is the murderous character from The Threepenny Opera and its famous song

explanation.surface: Swindle a gangster called Mack, and take some pleasure in the cruelty.
explanation.walkthrough: Mack is short for Mack the Knife, the killer in Brecht and Weill's The Threepenny Opera.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: making someone's pain worse on purpose is a small act of cruelty, hence the question mark on 'sadism'.

clue.text: Shrewd-sounding Scots can't give battle

indicators.note: sounding says the word for shrewd is said aloud, giving a word that sounds like it

parts.note: canny means shrewd

explanation.surface: Shrewd Scotsmen are unable to offer a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scots can't' gives the same word a second way: cannae is Scots for can't.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannae was Hannibal's great victory over the Romans in 216 BC.

clue.text: Some yobs are up — to receive this?

definitions.text: Some yobs are up — to receive this?

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters read from bottom to top
some says only part of the words yobs are is used

explanation.surface: Some young hooligans are on the rise: what do they deserve?
explanation.walkthrough: An ASBO (anti-social behaviour order) was a British court order against yobbish conduct, so the whole clue also defines the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Yobs are the kind of people who used to be given anti-social behaviour orders in Britain.

clue.text: Trap with bouncer in game

parts.note: a net is a trap for fish or birds
a ball is something that bounces

explanation.surface: A snare holding a nightclub doorman features in some sport.
explanation.definitionFit: Netball is a team game, played mainly by women, with a ball and high netted hoops.

clue.text: Where to get loaded, perhaps, stuffed with gold?

definitions.text: Where to get loaded, perhaps, stuffed with gold?

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are filled with the word for gold
perhaps says the letters of loaded may be arranged another way

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A place to strike it rich, crammed with gold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' gives ELDADO, which 'stuffed with' fills with heraldic gold; the whole clue also describes the legendary city of riches.
explanation.definitionFit: El Dorado was the legendary city of gold, so it is where one would become rich.

clue.text: Back in time, I am an egg

indicators.note: back says the word in is read the other way round

explanation.surface: Speaking from the past, something announces that it is an egg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' gives NI; the nit speaks for itself in 'I am an egg', a louse egg.
explanation.definitionFit: A nit is the egg of a louse, so the clue lets the nit speak for itself.

clue.text: Not self-conscious as one leaves for a desert here

indicators.note: one, the letter I, leaves and the letter A takes its place

parts.note: uninhibited means free of self-consciousness

explanation.surface: Someone loses their shyness as a companion departs for the desert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one leaves for a' means the letter I is replaced by A.
explanation.definitionFit: A desert is a place where no one lives, so somewhere deserted can be described as empty of people.

clue.text: Protection against whiplash started hernia off

indicators.note: off means the letters of started hernia are out of order

explanation.surface: A hernia began to act up after a car injury.
explanation.definitionFit: A head restraint in a car seat supports the head and protects against whiplash in a collision.

clue.text: One used to glance as two fliers meet

parts.note: a cricket is a flying insect
a bat is a flying mammal

explanation.surface: Two flying creatures come together in a passing look.
explanation.walkthrough: A glance is a cricket stroke that deflects the ball fine off the bat.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a glance is a deflecting stroke, played with the bat.

clue.text: Area covered by wood is considerable

indicators.note: the area letter is placed inside the wood

parts.note: fir is a tree, a source of wood

explanation.surface: A large stretch is covered by forest.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair can mean sizeable, as in a fair amount or a fair distance.

clue.text: Orient footballers maybe used to exercise in the gym

definitions.text: used to exercise in the gym

parts.note: the Orient is the East, and Indian is an eastern nationality
a football team is a club

explanation.surface: Leyton Orient players train in the gym.
explanation.walkthrough: Leyton Orient is a London football club, so 'Orient footballers' looks like a team name.
explanation.definitionFit: Indian clubs are bottle-shaped wooden weights swung to exercise the arms.

clue.text: Don't let go of contents of nest

definitions.meaning: the set of eggs laid in a nest at one time

explanation.definitionFit: Clutch means grasp tightly, and also a batch of eggs a bird sits on.

clue.text: Joint presented in a way that didn't please

indicators.note: the joint is placed inside the way

parts.note: RD is short for road, a way
the ankle is a joint

explanation.surface: A joint was served in a manner the diner disliked.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that rankled caused lasting annoyance, so it displeased.

clue.text: Employed to keep books, wife started probably illegally

indicators.note: the employed word holds the books and wife inside it

parts.note: hired means employed
OT, the Old Testament, is a set of books

explanation.surface: A bookkeeper's wife began work, probably against the law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to keep' places the books and the wife inside the employed word; the Old Testament is a crossword's usual 'books'.
explanation.definitionFit: To hot-wire a car is to start it by bypassing the ignition, typically when stealing it.

clue.text: Arid interior, blooming in the past

parts.note: flowers that are out are in bloom
back means in the past, as in back then

explanation.surface: A desert landscape once flowered long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: The outback is the dry, sparsely inhabited interior of Australia.

clue.text: Do this with the towel perhaps that's taken off the field

definitions.text: Do this with the towel perhaps
definitions.meaning: to give up is to ... the towel
in football a ... is taken by a player standing off the pitch

explanation.definitionFit: Throw in the towel means surrender; a throw-in restarts football from beyond the touchline.

clue.text: Fairy -— it is about to stop breathing

indicators.note: about says the letters of the whole sequence are turned round

parts.note: an elf is a fairy
it is shortens to it's

explanation.surface: A fairy says it is close to suffocating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns ELF and ITS together, giving the letters backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To stifle someone is to smother them, cutting off their air.

clue.text: For fear, closing old house in the country

indicators.note: the for fear word closes around the old letter

parts.note: lest means for fear that

explanation.surface: Afraid of shutting down an ancient home in the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Lesotho is a mountain kingdom entirely surrounded by South Africa.

clue.text: Keep talking tediously? Exactly

explanation.definitionFit: Bang on is British slang for drone on, and also for spot-on, absolutely accurate.

clue.text: After conflict, died in custody

indicators.note: the died letter comes after the conflict word

parts.note: war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: Once the war ended, a prisoner perished in jail.
explanation.definitionFit: Ward means guardianship or protective keeping, as in a child in ward of court.

clue.text: Incomer is a stranger in islands

indicators.note: stranger means the letters of incomer is a appear in a stranger order

explanation.surface: A newcomer is an outsider in an archipelago.
explanation.definitionFit: Micronesia is a region of small Pacific islands, and also a nation made of them.

clue.text: I party over island

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the sequence is flipped to read upwards

parts.note: Lab is short for the Labour Party

explanation.surface: I hold a celebration on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Bali is an Indonesian island east of Java.

clue.text: Artist's mother in law I cultivated, not the finished article

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is a crossword artist

indicators.note: the mother word goes inside the rearranged letters
cultivated means the letters of law and I are worked over into a new order

parts.note: mater is Latin for mother

explanation.surface: An artist's mother-in-law, whom I polished, was still unrefined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cultivated' gives WIAL, and 'in' opens it for the Latin mother; 'mother in law' is a false phrase splitting at 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Raw material is unprocessed stuff from which finished goods are made.

clue.text: Measure of warmth, though, evens out

indicators.note: removing the even-numbered letters of though leaves its first, third and fifth

explanation.surface: Gauging heat, though, balances out.
explanation.definitionFit: A tog is a unit for rating the insulating warmth of duvets and clothing.

clue.text: My bill goes down a bit, but debt collector gets nothing back

definitions.text: My bill goes down a bit

parts.note: a dun is someone who demands payment of a debt

indicators.note: back says the word for nothing is reversed

parts.note: nil means nothing

explanation.surface: My invoice drops slightly, but the bailiff is left empty-handed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My bill' is a bird's beak, not an invoice: the bird speaks of its slightly downcurved bill.
explanation.definitionFit: The dunlin is a small wading bird whose longish bill curves gently downward at the tip.

clue.text: Bob turns out to be refractory

indicators.note: out means the letters of Bob turns are put out of order

explanation.surface: Bob proves obstinate.
explanation.definitionFit: Refractory means resisting control, which is obstinate and unyielding.
